address: Via alla Chiesa 8, Castel San Pietro, 6874, Switzerland
bio: Just above Mendrisio, this charming little village, complete with a historic center and church, offers both visitors and locals a beautiful Lombard-style farmhouse, where the refined restaurant serves modern Italian cuisine with regional influences, as well as a variety of caviar selections and excellent vegetables (the pigeon with carrots is a must-have). The wine list benefits from its own cellar, featuring regional labels and Champagne....
